samples.xml_description:
<module id="pulse_detect">
    <description>Pulse detector module to detect rising edges of a 1-bit input signal data_in.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock signal.</input>
        <input id="rst_n">Active-low reset signal.</input>
        <input id="data_in">One-bit input signal.</input>
        <output id="data_out">Output signal indicating the presence of pulses.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter name="IDLE">Waiting for a rising edge.</parameter>
        <parameter name="RISING">Detected rising edge, waiting for next edge.</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <reg id="current_state" width_description="1">Register to hold the current state.</reg>
        <reg id="previous_data_in" width_description="1">Register to store the previous value of data_in.</reg>
        <wire id="data_out_reg" width_description="1">Wire to hold the value of data_out before assigning it to the output port.</wire>
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (!rst_n) begin
                current_state <= IDLE;
                previous_data_in <= 0;
                data_out_reg <= 0;
            end else begin
                case (current_state)
                    IDLE: begin
                        if (data_in && !previous_data_in) begin
                            current_state <= RISING;
                            data_out_reg <= 0;
                        end else begin
                            current_state <= IDLE;
                            data_out_reg <= 0;
                        end
                    end
                    RISING: begin
                        if (!data_in) begin
                            current_state <= IDLE;
                            data_out_reg <= 1;
                        end else begin
                            current_state <= RISING;
                            data_out_reg <= 0;
                        end
                    end
                endcase
                previous_data_in <= data_in;
            end
        end
        assign data_out = data_out_reg;
    </implementation>
</module>
